card.name: Last word inside nested parentheses
card.fires_on: The final word or letter just before a closing parenthesis that closes an inner parenthetical already nested inside another parenthesis, as in label text such as (Step 1 (a)) or (25° C (77° F)).

modes.label: Inner abbreviation or letter
modes.description: A short abbreviation, letter or number that ends an inner parenthetical or bracket inside an outer parenthesis.

modes.label: Unit or plural ending
modes.description: A unit, plural ending or word piece that finishes a nested parenthetical, right before two closing parentheses.

card.writes: It pushes toward closing brackets that end a nested group and away from a single closing parenthesis plus a quote mark.
card.plain: It fires on the last bit inside a bracket that sits inside another bracket, just before the double closing marks.
